source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1958, p. 5 ("Rural councils: results of polling"); Strabane Chronicle, 14 June 1958, p. 2 ("Notice of Result of Elections: Rural District of Strabane, 1958")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. Ballymagorry was contested (Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1958, p. 5). The Belfast News-Letter of 21 May 1958, p. 11 also reported a contest in Ardstraw, but the Returning Officer's Notice of Result (Strabane Chronicle, 14 June 1958, p. 2) enters a single candidate there; all 28 divisions are recorded from the notice.
correctionNote: Corrected (council-audit, Nov 2026): the Belfast News-Letter (6 June 1958, p. 5) prints 'Robert F. Cumings'; the surname is filed as Cummings, as the Returning Officer's notice prints it (Strabane Chronicle, 14 June 1958, p. 2) and as the Strabane Chronicle prints him for Dunamanagh in 1967 ('R. F. Cummings', 20 May 1967, p. 8, image read). Name_As_Printed keeps the News-Letter's form.
